searchText: With altair the constants have been broken out in to constants, presets and configuration. I think that all of these need to be returned by the `/eth/v1/config/spec` endpoint, as they all have values that are required by validator clients. If no-one objects to this I will raise a PR that clearly states this in the API documentation, make sense 👍
